definitions.explanation: The act of telling others something that should be kept secret or confidential. Almost always used in negative constructions meaning 'do not reveal.'

examples.japanese: {口外|こうがい}⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口外|こうがい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: You must never reveal this matter to anyone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{機密情報|きみつじょうほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{口外|こうがい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: An employee who disclosed confidential company information was disciplined.

notes:
Composed of {口|こう} (mouth) + ⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outside) — literally "putting outside one's mouth," i.e., speaking aloud what should remain unspoken. Almost exclusively used in prohibitive or negative contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口外|こうがい}⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧ (not reveal)
- {口外|こうがい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧ (must not disclose)
- {口外|こうがい}{無用|むよう} (do not disclose; confidential)
- {口外|こうがい}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (disclosure prohibited)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{漏|も}らす→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧ — to leak (information), to let slip (more colloquial)
- ⟦{暴露|ばくろ}→暴露：07630_bakuro⟧ — exposure, revelation (often of scandals or wrongdoing)
- ⟦{吐露|とろ}→吐露：11895_toro⟧ — confession, revealing one's feelings (more personal and emotional)
